scope: Completed, independently reviewed diagnostic/correctness work in plans/ci-performance; no source or canonical ledger mutation.
credit_rule: A credit requires a distinct hypothesis, a measured intervention or diagnostic, and an independently checked conclusion. Documentation, unchanged reruns, opinions, and artificial splitting do not count.

candidates.hypothesis: The pinned Mr. Boxington directory transport can export/import a cache directory without the prior quota failure.
candidates.measurement: Successful manual-dispatch run 35481387575 exercised MBX 1.12.0/action 1.4 directory transport; failed run 35480920648 retained as a negative control.
candidates.scope_boundary: Count transport only. Bootstrap/policy compatibility remains HOLD; compiler reuse and performance remain unproven.

candidates.hypothesis: The scanner watch set must retain Bun/TypeScript inputs required by the UI producer; the old watch omission is a correctness defect.
candidates.measurement: Focused fixture: the old branch fails on a changed TypeScript input while the candidate preserves the input and passes. Exact PR CI run 35488747612 passed its executed/required gates.
candidates.independent_check: Independent renderer-level review by /root/jackin_inventory; experiment record documents the regression and command preservation.
candidates.scope_boundary: Correctness/coverage diagnostic only. No elapsed-time or cache-hit improvement accepted.

candidates.hypothesis: Declared Mise tools must have lock membership and generated installs must use --locked; missing lock data must fail before CI execution.
candidates.measurement: Actual Mise 2026.9.11 macOS ARM probes showed missing lock membership fails and plain install attempts an offline installation; focused generation/runtime fixtures cover both providers.
candidates.independent_check: Independent contract review by /root/parallax_inventory; focused tests, Clippy, fmt, and generated checks passed. The canceled exact CI run is retained as a negative validation path, not a success claim.
candidates.scope_boundary: Count the lock/provisioning unit once. Mise bootstrap and scheduled-child fixture repairs are supporting work, not extra credits.

candidates.hypothesis: Running fmt, then Clippy, then the existing test command gives earlier actionable failure feedback while preserving the command multiset and coverage.
candidates.measurement: Five deliberate failure/ordering samples measured the candidate and opposite orders; the failure-feedback mechanism reproduced, while shared-host load confounded timing.
candidates.independent_check: plans/ci-performance/reviews/rust-order-review.md independently replayed the fixture and marked the mechanism valid but held any Velnor performance claim.
candidates.scope_boundary: Diagnostic feedback-order credit only. No speedup, target-baseline, or plateau credit.

candidates.hypothesis: The rolling publication failure boundary must preserve the lock, terminate the verifier process group, and perform rollback exactly once across supported Bash versions.
candidates.measurement: Bash 3.2 and 5.x false, explicit-exit, pipeline, function, success, TERM/KILL, and cleanup fixtures exercised the boundary; exact CI run 35508236735 passed the generated test/gate set.
candidates.independent_check: plans/ci-performance/reviews/upstream-9e5-integration-review.md independently checked the final foreground verifier, process cleanup, lock retention, and rollback assertions.
candidates.scope_boundary: Correctness diagnostic only. Real scheduler cancellation replay remains separate and unvalidated; do not claim a scheduling or runtime reduction.

candidates.hypothesis: The Rust embed-ui build script must reject missing, empty, stub, symlink, and special-file products instead of fabricating _shell.html.
candidates.measurement: Final guard fixtures reject invalid products and accept a real product; the baseline accepts invalid cases. Final review also checked the generated selection/runtime provenance.
candidates.scope_boundary: Not in the canonical Velnor experiment index. Canonicalize as one UI correctness unit before counting; do not split guard and watch-selection evidence.

candidates.reason: The initial truth-table repair was independently reviewed, but generated/live schema4 parity and complete phase attribution were still pending; later writer phases also exposed aggregate/chronology gaps.
The record is an unchanged bounded rerun. Collector correctness fixes are valuable evidence integrity work, but must not be counted as a second performance iteration or split from the rerun.

The initial red/green lookup result was superseded by the later ownership race: SHA equality does not prove tag creation ownership. The replacement fix needs its own exact CI proof; do not count both stages.
The isolated pin propagation test passed, but independent review found the global downgrade unsafe: it loses current runtime behavior and fails the current policy fixture.

excluded_nested_or_pending: V-SCHEDULED-CHECK-001: supporting fixture for locked provisioning; do not count separately.
V-MISE-CLOSURE-001, V-POLICY-001, V-IDENTITY-001, V-WATCH-001, V-GATE-001, V-METADATA-STAGING-001, V-CANCELLATION-001: pending, held, or missing required independent/real-CI proof.
V-MBX-REUSE-001: diagnosis/design remains pending controlled observations.
V-CONSUMER-RUNTIME-001: candidate rollout and independent realtime proof pending.
JACKIN-DESKTOP-001: diagnosis only; no intervention with accepted measured conclusion.
audit_conclusion: Five diagnostic/correctness credits are defensible if section 13 permits non-performance iterations. Performance acceptance remains zero, plateau remains zero, and no timing improvement is claimed. The Parallax UI unit is a sixth candidate only after canonical experiment indexing; all other listed work stays zero or pending.
